_comment: Import with: sudo nginx-gateway-ctl projects import /path/to/this.json  (or Settings > Import in the dashboard). Names and ports are examples: use your own.

projects.name: Vite app with an API
projects.notes: Start with: VITE_API_BASE=/vite-with-api/api npm run dev -- --base /vite-with-api/ --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort. The backend needs no change.

projects.name: App with many backend routes
projects.notes: The backend has many top-level routes (/login, /users, ...), so they live under /many-routes-api/backend/ with strip_all. Start the frontend with VITE_API_BASE_URL=/many-routes-api/backend. The backend needs no change.

projects.name: Next.js app on its own port
projects.notes: Next.js app with many fetch('/api/...') calls: its own gateway port needs no code change. Make the app listen on 127.0.0.1 so only the gateway reaches it.
